recipes.name: Greek Yogurt Berry Protein Bowl
steps: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl
Top with berries, granola and chia seeds
Drizzle with honey and eat right away

recipes.name: Spinach and Feta Egg White Omelette
steps: Whisk the egg whites and egg with salt and pepper
Wilt the spinach in the oil in a non-stick pan
Pour in the eggs and cook on medium until almost set
Scatter over feta and tomatoes, fold and serve

recipes.name: Overnight Protein Oats
steps: Stir oats, milk, yogurt, protein powder and chia together in a jar
Cover and refrigerate overnight
Top with banana in the morning

recipes.name: Shakshuka
ing: parsley and a little feta to serve
steps: Soften onion and pepper in the oil for 6 minutes
Add garlic and spices for 1 minute
Pour in tomatoes and simmer 8 minutes until thick
Make 4 wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook 6 to 8 minutes
Finish with parsley and feta

recipes.name: Avocado Toast with Poached Egg
steps: Poach the eggs in simmering water for 3 minutes
Toast the bread
Mash avocado with lemon and salt and spread on toast
Top with the eggs and chili flakes

recipes.name: Cottage Cheese Pancakes
steps: Blend cottage cheese, eggs, oat flour, baking powder and vanilla
Rest the batter 5 minutes
Cook small pancakes in a lightly oiled pan 2 minutes per side
Serve with berries

recipes.name: Turkey and Veggie Breakfast Burrito
steps: Brown the turkey with onion and pepper
Push aside and scramble the eggs in the same pan
Fill the tortillas with turkey, eggs, cheese and salsa
Roll tightly and toast seam-side down

recipes.name: Green Power Smoothie Bowl
steps: Blend banana, spinach, yogurt, milk and almond butter until thick
Pour into a bowl
Top with sliced kiwi and seeds

recipes.name: Savory Oatmeal with Egg and Greens
steps: Simmer oats in water or stock for 5 minutes
Stir in the kale until wilted
Fry the egg
Season the oats with soy sauce and sesame oil, top with egg and spring onion

recipes.name: Egg Muffins with Peppers and Ham
steps: Heat oven to 180°C and grease a 12-hole muffin tin
Whisk eggs with salt and pepper
Divide ham, pepper and spring onion between the holes and pour over the egg
Top with cheese and bake 18 to 20 minutes

recipes.name: Banana Oat Protein Pancakes
steps: Blend all ingredients except the oil
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan
Cook small pancakes for 2 minutes per side
Serve with a spoon of yogurt if you like

recipes.name: Smoked Salmon Scrambled Eggs
steps: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of pepper
Cook gently in butter, stirring, until just set
Fold through salmon and chives
Serve with the crispbread

recipes.name: Chia Pudding with Mango
steps: Whisk chia, almond milk, maple and vanilla
Rest 10 minutes, whisk again, then chill 4 hours or overnight
Top with mango

recipes.name: Tofu Scramble with Spinach
steps: Crumble the tofu
Soften the onion in the oil
Add tofu, turmeric and yeast and cook 5 minutes
Stir through spinach and season well

recipes.name: Breakfast Quinoa Bowl
steps: Simmer quinoa in the almond milk with cinnamon for 15 minutes
Stir in the apple
Top with walnuts and maple syrup

recipes.name: Huevos Rancheros
steps: Warm the beans with half the salsa
Fry the eggs in the oil
Toast the tortillas in a dry pan
Layer tortilla, beans, eggs, remaining salsa, avocado and coriander

recipes.name: Protein French Toast
steps: Whisk eggs, milk, protein powder and cinnamon
Soak each slice briefly
Cook in butter 2 to 3 minutes per side
Serve with berries

recipes.name: Mediterranean Breakfast Plate
steps: Slice eggs, cucumber and tomatoes
Arrange everything on a plate with the hummus
Warm the pita and serve alongside

recipes.name: Buckwheat Porridge with Berries
steps: Simmer buckwheat in water with salt for 10 minutes
Add oat milk and cook 3 more minutes
Top with berries and maple syrup

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
steps: Toast the bread
Spread with peanut butter
Top with banana and hemp seeds

recipes.name: Veggie Frittata
steps: Heat oven to 190°C
Soften vegetables in the oil in an ovenproof pan
Pour in beaten eggs with parmesan
Cook 3 minutes on the stove, then bake 12 minutes
Finish with basil

recipes.name: Apple Cinnamon Baked Oats
steps: Heat oven to 180°C
Mix everything except the walnuts
Pour into a small baking dish and scatter walnuts on top
Bake 30 minutes and cut into 4

recipes.name: Egg and Black Bean Breakfast Bowl
steps: Warm the beans and rice
Fry or scramble the eggs
Build the bowl and top with avocado, salsa and coriander

recipes.name: Skyr with Rhubarb Compote
steps: Simmer rhubarb with honey, water and cardamom 8 minutes
Cool slightly
Spoon over the skyr

recipes.name: Turkish Menemen
steps: Soften the pepper in the oil
Add tomatoes and cook down 5 minutes
Stir in the beaten eggs gently until soft and just set
Finish with chili flakes

recipes.name: Cottage Cheese Breakfast Bowl
steps: Spoon cottage cheese into a bowl
Top with peach and almonds
Finish with honey and cinnamon

recipes.name: Sweet Potato Hash with Eggs
steps: Fry the sweet potato in the oil for 10 minutes
Add onion, pepper and paprika and cook 5 minutes
Make 4 wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook until set

recipes.name: Protein Waffles
steps: Whisk everything into a batter
Cook in a hot waffle iron until golden
Serve with berries and yogurt

recipes.name: Congee with Ginger and Egg
steps: Simmer rice in stock with ginger, stirring often, for 35 minutes until creamy
Halve the soft-boiled eggs
Serve topped with egg, spring onion, soy and a drop of sesame oil

recipes.name: Breakfast Tacos with Chorizo and Egg
steps: Crisp the chorizo in a dry pan
Scramble the eggs in the chorizo fat
Warm the tortillas
Fill with eggs, onion, coriander and a squeeze of lime

recipes.name: Protein Porridge
steps: Cook oats in milk for 5 minutes
Take off the heat and stir in the protein powder
Top with banana and peanut butter

recipes.name: Mushroom and Spinach Egg Scramble
steps: Fry mushrooms in the butter until golden
Add spinach to wilt
Pour in beaten eggs and stir gently until set
Finish with parmesan

recipes.name: Acai Bowl
ing: toppings: 1 tbsp gluten-free granola, berries, 1 tsp coconut flakes
steps: Blend acai, banana and almond milk until thick
Pour into a bowl
Add the toppings

recipes.name: Ricotta and Pear Toast
steps: Toast the bread
Spread with ricotta
Top with pear, honey and pistachios

recipes.name: Spanish Tortilla
steps: Cook potato and onion slowly in the oil, covered, for 20 minutes
Mix with the beaten eggs and salt
Return to the pan and cook on low 6 minutes
Flip with a plate and cook 3 more minutes

recipes.name: Oat and Egg White Omelette
steps: Blitz the oats to a flour
Whisk with egg whites, egg and cinnamon
Cook like a thick pancake in a non-stick pan, flipping once
Serve with berries

recipes.name: Lox Bagel Thin
steps: Toast the bagel thin
Spread with cream cheese
Top with salmon, onion, capers and dill

recipes.name: Quinoa Egg Breakfast Bowl
steps: Toss quinoa and rocket with oil, lemon and salt
Halve the eggs
Top with eggs and avocado

recipes.name: Berry Protein Smoothie
steps: Blend everything until smooth
Add water if too thick

recipes.name: Tempeh Breakfast Hash
steps: Fry the potato in the oil 8 minutes
Add tempeh, onion and pepper and cook 7 minutes
Season with paprika and tamari

recipes.name: Muesli Bircher Style
steps: Mix oats, apple, milk, yogurt and honey
Soak overnight in the fridge
Top with hazelnuts

recipes.name: Egg White Breakfast Wrap
steps: Scramble the egg whites with spinach
Warm the tortilla
Fill with eggs, mozzarella and salsa and roll

recipes.name: Pumpkin Spice Oatmeal
steps: Cook oats in milk for 5 minutes
Stir in pumpkin, spice and maple
Top with pecans

recipes.name: Ful Medames
steps: Warm the beans with a splash of their liquid and mash lightly
Stir in garlic, cumin and lemon
Top with tomato, parsley and olive oil

recipes.name: Baked Eggs with Tomato and Spinach
steps: Heat oven to 190°C
Wilt spinach and spread in a small dish with passata
Crack in eggs and top with feta
Bake 12 minutes until the whites set

recipes.name: Coconut Yogurt Parfait
steps: Layer yogurt, berries and granola in a glass
Sprinkle with flaxseed

recipes.name: Steak and Eggs
steps: Season and sear the steak 3 minutes per side, then rest
Fry the eggs
Blister the tomatoes in the same pan
Slice the steak and serve with eggs and tomatoes

recipes.name: Japanese Tamagoyaki with Rice
steps: Whisk eggs with soy, mirin and sugar
Cook thin layers in an oiled pan, rolling each one
Slice and serve with rice and nori

recipes.name: Almond Butter Berry Oats
steps: Cook the oats in oat milk for 5 minutes
Top with almond butter, blueberries and maple

recipes.name: Crustless Spinach Quiche
steps: Heat oven to 180°C and grease a pie dish
Whisk eggs and milk with seasoning
Stir in spinach, onion and feta
Bake 30 to 35 minutes until set

recipes.name: Sardine Toast
ing: 1 can sardines in olive oil, drained
steps: Toast the bread and rub with the cut tomato
Top with sardines
Finish with lemon, parsley and pepper

recipes.name: Hemp Seed Breakfast Muffins
steps: Heat oven to 180°C
Mash bananas and whisk with eggs, milk, honey and oil
Fold in flour, baking powder and hemp seeds
Divide into 8 muffin cases and bake 20 minutes

recipes.name: Kefir Smoothie with Oats
steps: Blend everything until smooth
Drink right away

recipes.name: Moroccan Msemen-Style Egg Wrap
steps: Scramble eggs with cumin in the oil
Warm the flatbread
Fill with eggs, tomato, feta and mint and fold

recipes.name: Blueberry Protein Muffins
steps: Heat oven to 180°C
Mix wet and dry ingredients separately, then combine
Fold in blueberries
Bake in 6 muffin cases for 20 minutes

recipes.name: Greek Yogurt Cheesecake Cups
steps: Beat yogurt, cream cheese, honey and vanilla until smooth
Layer biscuit crumbs and the cream in 4 glasses
Top with berries and chill 1 hour

recipes.name: Dark Chocolate Avocado Mousse
steps: Blend everything until silky
Chill 30 minutes
Serve with berries

recipes.name: Baked Apples with Oats and Cinnamon
steps: Mix oats, walnuts, honey, cinnamon and butter
Stuff into the apples
Bake at 180°C for 25 to 30 minutes

recipes.name: Protein Brownies
steps: Heat oven to 180°C
Mash bananas and mix with eggs and peanut butter
Stir in cocoa, protein powder and baking powder
Fold in chips, spread in a lined tin and bake 20 minutes
cut into 12

recipes.name: Mixed Berry Crumble (Lighter)
ing: topping: 80 g rolled oats, 30 g almond flour, 2 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp butter, cinnamon
steps: Toss berries with cornstarch and maple in a dish
Rub the topping ingredients together
Scatter over and bake at 180°C for 30 minutes

recipes.name: Frozen Banana Nice Cream
steps: Blend until creamy like soft-serve
Eat right away or freeze 1 hour for scoopable

recipes.name: Chocolate Peanut Butter Nice Cream
steps: Blend until smooth and thick
Serve immediately

recipes.name: Poached Pears in Red Wine
steps: Bring wine with maple and spices to a simmer
Poach the pears 25 minutes, turning
Remove the pears and reduce the liquid to a syrup
Serve with the syrup

recipes.name: Chia Chocolate Pudding
steps: Whisk everything together
Rest 10 minutes and whisk again
Chill 3 hours or overnight

recipes.name: Strawberries with Balsamic and Yogurt
steps: Toss strawberries with balsamic and honey
Rest 10 minutes
Serve over yogurt with mint

recipes.name: Protein Ice Cream
steps: Blend until thick
Eat right away or freeze 30 minutes

recipes.name: Oat and Banana Cookies with Chocolate
steps: Mash bananas, mix with oats, chips and peanut butter
Spoon onto a lined tray
Bake at 180°C for 15 minutes

recipes.name: Grilled Peaches with Ricotta and Honey
steps: Grill the peaches cut-side down 4 minutes
Top with ricotta, honey and pistachios
Garnish with mint

recipes.name: Lemon Yogurt Loaf (Lighter)
steps: Heat oven to 180°C
Whisk yogurt, eggs, sugar, oil and lemon
Fold in flour and baking powder
Bake in a lined loaf tin 45 minutes

recipes.name: Dark Chocolate Dipped Strawberries
steps: Melt the chocolate
Dip each strawberry halfway
Set on a lined tray, sprinkle with salt and chill

recipes.name: Rice Pudding with Cinnamon
steps: Simmer rice in milk with cinnamon and lemon peel, stirring often, for 35 minutes
Stir in honey
Serve warm or cold dusted with cinnamon

recipes.name: Mango Sorbet
steps: Blend until smooth
Serve right away or freeze 1 hour

recipes.name: Protein Chocolate Mug Cake
steps: Mix everything in a mug
Microwave 60 to 70 seconds

recipes.name: Carrot Cake Energy Bites
steps: Blend dates, walnuts and oats
Add carrot and spices and blend briefly
Roll into 12 balls and chill

recipes.name: Tiramisu Overnight Oats
steps: Mix oats with espresso and half the maple
Whisk yogurt with protein powder and remaining maple
Layer in 2 jars and dust with cocoa
Chill overnight

recipes.name: Berry Yogurt Parfait
steps: Layer yogurt, berries and granola
Drizzle with honey

recipes.name: Baked Pears with Walnuts and Maple
steps: Arrange pears cut-side up
Fill with walnuts, drizzle with maple and cinnamon
Bake at 180°C for 25 minutes

recipes.name: Coconut Panna Cotta with Passion Fruit
steps: Bring coconut milk, maple and agar to the boil, whisking, for 2 minutes
Add vanilla and pour into 4 molds
Chill 2 hours until set
Top with passion fruit

recipes.name: Flourless Chocolate Oat Cake
steps: Heat oven to 180°C
Blend everything except the chocolate
Pour into a lined tin, scatter chopped chocolate
Bake 25 minutes

recipes.name: Cinnamon Baked Bananas
steps: Arrange the bananas in a small dish
Dot with butter, honey and cinnamon
Bake at 200°C for 10 minutes
Serve with yogurt

recipes.name: Protein Peanut Butter Cups
steps: Melt half the chocolate into 12 mini cases and chill
Mix peanut butter, protein and maple and add a spoonful to each
Top with the rest of the melted chocolate and chill until set

recipes.name: Frozen Yogurt Berry Bites
steps: Stir honey into the yogurt
Coat each blueberry cluster and drop onto a lined tray
Freeze 2 hours

recipes.name: Apple Nachos
steps: Fan the apple slices on a plate
Drizzle with peanut butter and chocolate
Sprinkle with coconut and almonds

recipes.name: Black Bean Brownies
steps: Blend everything except the chips until very smooth
Fold in the chips
Bake in a lined tin at 180°C for 25 minutes
Cool before cutting into 12

recipes.name: Matcha Yogurt Pots
steps: Whisk matcha and honey into the yogurt
Spoon into pots
Top with raspberries

recipes.name: Sticky Date Bites with Tahini
steps: Fill each date with a little tahini
Roll the tops in sesame seeds
Sprinkle with salt

recipes.name: Watermelon Pizza
steps: Spread yogurt mixed with honey over the watermelon
Top with fruit and mint
Cut into wedges

recipes.name: Lemon Ricotta Pancake Stack (Dessert)
steps: Whisk ricotta, eggs and lemon zest
Fold in flour and baking powder
Cook small pancakes in a non-stick pan
Stack with berries and honey

recipes.name: Protein Cheesecake (No Bake)
ing: filling: 400 g quark or skyr, 150 g light cream cheese, 30 g vanilla protein powder, 3 tbsp honey, 1 tsp vanilla
steps: Blend oats and dates and press into a lined tin
Beat the filling ingredients until smooth and spread over
Chill at least 4 hours
Top with berries

recipes.name: Spiced Poached Quince
steps: Simmer everything gently for 50 minutes until rosy and tender
Serve warm with a little syrup

recipes.name: Chocolate Chip Chickpea Blondies
steps: Blend chickpeas, peanut butter, maple, vanilla and baking powder
Fold in chips
Bake in a lined tin at 180°C for 20 minutes

recipes.name: Kiwi and Lime Granita
steps: Blend everything
Pour into a shallow tray and freeze, scraping with a fork every 45 minutes for 3 hours

recipes.name: Almond Flour Blueberry Muffins
steps: Whisk wet ingredients
Stir in almond flour and baking powder
Fold in blueberries
Bake in 10 cases at 180°C for 20 minutes

recipes.name: Pistachio and Rose Yogurt Bowl
steps: Stir rose water and honey into the yogurt
Top with pistachios, petals and pomegranate

recipes.name: Hot Chocolate Protein Custard
steps: Whisk milk, cocoa and cornstarch in a pan
Simmer, whisking, until thick
Off the heat whisk in protein and maple
Serve warm or chilled

recipes.name: Stuffed Dates with Almonds and Dark Chocolate
steps: Stuff each date with an almond
Drizzle with chocolate and let set

recipes.name: Orange and Cardamom Chia Pots
steps: Whisk everything together
Chill 3 hours or overnight
Top with orange segments

recipes.name: Chocolate Peanut Butter Protein Shake
steps: Blend until smooth

recipes.name: Green Detox Smoothie
steps: Blend until smooth and drink right away

recipes.name: Mango Lassi (Protein)
steps: Blend until smooth

recipes.name: Iced Matcha Latte
steps: Whisk matcha with hot water until frothy
Pour over ice and milk
Sweeten with honey

recipes.name: Golden Turmeric Milk
steps: Warm everything in a small pan, whisking
Strain and drink warm

recipes.name: Coffee Protein Shake
steps: Blend until frothy

recipes.name: Watermelon Mint Cooler
steps: Blend watermelon with mint and lime
Pour over ice

recipes.name: Berry Beet Recovery Smoothie
steps: Blend until smooth

recipes.name: Tropical Protein Smoothie
steps: Blend until smooth

recipes.name: Ginger Lemon Tea
steps: Steep the ginger 5 minutes
Add lemon and maple

recipes.name: Electrolyte Trail Drink
steps: Shake everything in your bottle
Drink during long hikes or hot sessions

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Banana Oat Smoothie
steps: Blend until smooth and thick

recipes.name: Spiced Hot Cocoa (Lighter)
steps: Whisk everything in a pan until steaming

recipes.name: Strawberry Banana Protein Smoothie
steps: Blend until smooth

recipes.name: Kefir Berry Smoothie
steps: Blend until smooth

recipes.name: Iced Green Tea with Citrus
steps: Brew and cool the tea
Pour over ice with citrus and mint

recipes.name: Chocolate Cherry Recovery Shake
steps: Blend until smooth

recipes.name: Avocado Spinach Smoothie
steps: Blend until silky

recipes.name: Vanilla Almond Protein Shake
steps: Blend until frothy

recipes.name: Apple Cinnamon Overnight Smoothie
steps: Soak oats in milk overnight
Blend with the rest in the morning

recipes.name: Cold Brew Coffee
steps: Stir coffee into the water
Steep 12 to 16 hours in the fridge
Strain through a filter and serve over ice

recipes.name: Pineapple Ginger Smoothie
steps: Blend until smooth

recipes.name: Carrot Orange Juice Smoothie
steps: Blend with a splash of water until smooth

recipes.name: Mint Lemonade (Low Sugar)
steps: Blend lemon juice, mint and maple with a little water
Top up with water and ice

recipes.name: Cocoa Banana Recovery Milk
steps: Blend until smooth
drink within 30 minutes after training

recipes.name: Blueberry Oat Protein Smoothie
steps: Blend until smooth

recipes.name: Chai Protein Latte
steps: Steep the tea 4 minutes
Warm the milk and whisk in the protein
Combine

recipes.name: Hibiscus Iced Tea
steps: Steep hibiscus in hot water 10 minutes
Strain, sweeten and chill
Serve over ice with lime

recipes.name: Lemon Herb Grilled Chicken with Quinoa
steps: Marinate the chicken in lemon, garlic, oregano and half the oil
Cook the quinoa
Grill the chicken 6 minutes per side and rest
Toss quinoa with cucumber, tomatoes, parsley and the rest of the oil
serve with sliced chicken

recipes.name: Chicken Stir-Fry with Vegetables
steps: Stir-fry the chicken in hot oil until browned and remove
Stir-fry the vegetables with garlic and ginger 4 minutes
Return the chicken with the sauces and cornstarch mixed with a splash of water
Toss until glossy and serve with rice

recipes.name: Spaghetti Bolognese (Lean)
steps: Soften onion, carrot and celery in the oil
Brown the mince with the garlic
Add tomatoes, paste and oregano and simmer 25 minutes
Cook the spaghetti and toss with the sauce

recipes.name: Baked Salmon with Sweet Potato and Greens
steps: Roast the sweet potato with oil and paprika at 200°C for 15 minutes
Add salmon and green beans to the tray
Roast 12 more minutes
Finish with lemon

recipes.name: Grilled Sirloin Steak with Roasted Vegetables
steps: Roast the vegetables and potatoes with oil and rosemary at 200°C for 25 minutes
Season and sear the steaks 3 to 4 minutes per side
Rest 5 minutes, slice and serve with the vegetables

recipes.name: Turkey Chili
steps: Brown the turkey with onion and pepper in the oil
Add garlic and spices
Add tomatoes and beans and simmer 30 minutes
Serve with yogurt and coriander

recipes.name: Chicken Fajita Bowls
steps: Cook the rice
Toss chicken and vegetables with seasoning and oil
Cook in a hot pan 10 minutes
Build bowls with rice, beans, chicken and peppers, salsa and lime

recipes.name: Whole-Wheat Pasta Primavera with Chicken
steps: Cook the pasta
Sear the chicken in the oil and set aside
Cook the vegetables with garlic 5 minutes
Toss with pasta, chicken, parmesan, lemon and a splash of pasta water

recipes.name: Beef and Broccoli
steps: Toss the beef with cornstarch and 1 tbsp soy
Sear the beef in the oil and remove
Stir-fry broccoli with garlic and ginger, adding a splash of water
Return the beef with the remaining sauces and serve with rice

recipes.name: Cod with Tomatoes, Olives and Capers
steps: Sauté garlic in the oil
Add tomatoes, olives and capers and cook 5 minutes
Nestle the cod into the sauce, cover and cook 8 to 10 minutes
Finish with basil

recipes.name: Chicken Tikka Masala (Light)
steps: Marinate the chicken in half the yogurt and 1 tbsp paste
Brown the chicken and set aside
Cook onion, garlic, ginger and the rest of the paste
Add tomatoes and coconut milk and simmer 10 minutes
Return the chicken for 10 minutes and stir in the rest of the yogurt off the heat

recipes.name: Shrimp Tacos with Mango Salsa
steps: Mix mango, onion, jalapeño, coriander and lime into a salsa
Season shrimp with chili and cook in the oil 2 minutes per side
Warm the tortillas
Fill with cabbage, shrimp and salsa

recipes.name: Lamb Kofta with Tzatziki
ing: serve with salad and 100 g quinoa
steps: Mix lamb with onion, garlic, spices and parsley
Shape onto skewers
Grill 8 to 10 minutes, turning
Serve with tzatziki and salad

recipes.name: Teriyaki Salmon Rice Bowl
steps: Cook the rice
Simmer soy, mirin, honey and ginger into a glaze
Pan-fry the salmon and brush with the glaze
Build bowls with rice, salmon, avocado, cucumber and edamame

recipes.name: Lentil Bolognese
steps: Soften the vegetables in the oil
Add garlic, lentils, tomatoes, paste and 400 ml water
Simmer 25 minutes until the lentils are tender
Serve over the spaghetti

recipes.name: Chicken Shawarma Plate
steps: Marinate the chicken with spice, lemon, garlic and oil
Roast at 220°C for 25 minutes
Slice and serve with pita, salad and tahini

recipes.name: One-Pan Greek Chicken and Potatoes
steps: Toss everything except the stock in a roasting tin
Pour the stock around
Roast at 200°C for 45 minutes, turning once

recipes.name: Pork Tenderloin with Apples
steps: Sear the pork in the oil
Add onion and apples
Brush the pork with mustard and pour in the cider
Roast at 200°C for 18 to 20 minutes and rest before slicing

recipes.name: Tuna Pasta Salad
steps: Cook and cool the pasta
Mix with tuna, corn, onion and pepper
Dress with oil and vinegar and finish with parsley

recipes.name: Stuffed Bell Peppers with Turkey and Rice
steps: Heat oven to 190°C
Brown turkey and onion with cumin
Mix with rice and half the tomatoes
Fill the halved peppers, pour the remaining tomatoes around, top with cheese and bake 30 minutes

recipes.name: Chickpea and Spinach Curry
steps: Cook onion, garlic and ginger in the oil
Add curry paste for 1 minute
Add tomatoes, coconut milk and chickpeas and simmer 15 minutes
Stir in spinach until wilted

recipes.name: Pan-Seared Sea Bass with Lentils
steps: Simmer lentils with carrot and shallot 20 minutes and drain
Dress with mustard, vinegar and half the oil
Sear the fish skin-side down 4 minutes, flip for 1 minute
Serve on the lentils

recipes.name: Chicken Burrito Bowl
steps: Season and cook the chicken, then slice
Cook the rice with lime juice
Build bowls with lettuce, rice, beans, corn, chicken, salsa and cheese

recipes.name: Zucchini Noodles with Turkey Meatballs
steps: Mix turkey, egg, parmesan, garlic and oregano and roll into balls
Brown the meatballs in the oil
Add passata and simmer 15 minutes
Toss the zucchini noodles in a hot pan 2 minutes and serve with the meatballs

recipes.name: Shrimp Fried Rice
steps: Cook shrimp in the oil and remove
Scramble the eggs and push aside
Add vegetables and rice and stir-fry 4 minutes
Return the shrimp with soy sauce, sesame oil and spring onions

recipes.name: Beef Stew with Root Vegetables
steps: Brown the beef in batches in the oil
Soften the onions and stir in the tomato paste
Add stock, thyme and the beef and simmer covered for 90 minutes
Add the root vegetables and cook 40 minutes more

recipes.name: Grilled Chicken Souvlaki Wraps
steps: Marinate the chicken for at least 15 minutes
Thread onto skewers and grill 10 minutes
Warm the pitas
Fill with chicken, tomato, onion and tzatziki

recipes.name: Salmon Poke Bowl
steps: Cook and cool the rice
Marinate salmon in soy, sesame oil and vinegar
Build bowls with rice, salmon, avocado and vegetables
Sprinkle with sesame seeds

recipes.name: Black Bean Burgers
steps: Mash the beans and mix with oats, onion, spices and tomato paste
Shape 4 patties and chill 10 minutes
Cook in a lightly oiled pan 4 minutes per side
Serve in the buns with lettuce and tomato

recipes.name: Chicken Pho
steps: Simmer stock with onion, ginger, star anise and cinnamon for 20 minutes
Poach the chicken in it for 15 minutes, then slice
Strain and season with fish sauce
Pour over the cooked noodles and chicken
top with sprouts, basil, lime and chili

recipes.name: Mushroom Risotto (Lighter)
steps: Brown the mushrooms in half the oil and set aside
Soften onion and garlic in the rest of the oil
Toast the rice, add wine, then add hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for 18 minutes
Stir in mushrooms, thyme and parmesan

recipes.name: Harissa Chicken Traybake
steps: Toss chicken, vegetables and chickpeas with harissa and oil
Roast at 200°C for 35 minutes
Finish with lemon and coriander

recipes.name: Garlic Butter Shrimp with Zucchini Noodles
steps: Cook the shrimp in butter and oil with garlic 3 minutes
Add chili and the zucchini noodles and toss 2 minutes
Finish with lemon and parsley

recipes.name: Thai Green Curry with Chicken
steps: Fry the curry paste 1 minute
Add coconut milk and stock and bring to a simmer
Add chicken and vegetables and cook 10 minutes
Season with fish sauce and lime, add basil and serve with rice

recipes.name: Beef Tacos (Lean)
steps: Brown the mince with the onion
Add seasoning and a splash of water and simmer 5 minutes
Warm the tortillas
Fill with beef, lettuce, tomato, cheese, salsa and yogurt

recipes.name: Honey Garlic Salmon
steps: Mix honey, tamari and garlic
Sear the salmon in the oil 4 minutes skin-side down, flip
Pour in the sauce and let it bubble and thicken
Serve with steamed broccoli and spring onion

recipes.name: Chicken and Vegetable Traybake with Pesto
steps: Toss vegetables with oil and roast at 200°C for 10 minutes
Add the chicken brushed with pesto
Roast 20 minutes
Finish with parmesan

recipes.name: Vegetable Lasagna
steps: Roast the sliced vegetables with the oil 20 minutes
Mix ricotta, egg and spinach
Layer passata, sheets, vegetables and ricotta three times
Top with mozzarella and bake at 180°C for 35 minutes

recipes.name: Chicken Katsu (Baked)
ing: curry sauce: 1 onion, 1 tbsp curry powder, 400 ml stock, 1 tsp cornstarch
steps: Coat chicken in flour, egg and panko
Bake at 220°C on a rack for 20 minutes
Simmer onion, curry powder and stock, thicken with cornstarch and blend
Serve over rice with the sauce

recipes.name: Moroccan Lamb Tagine
steps: Brown the lamb in the oil
Soften onions and garlic with the spices
Add tomatoes, stock and lamb and simmer covered 75 minutes
Add chickpeas and apricots for 20 minutes
Finish with coriander

recipes.name: Tofu Stir-Fry with Peanut Sauce
ing: sauce: 2 tbsp peanut butter, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp lime juice, 1 tsp maple syrup, water
steps: Crisp the tofu in the oil and remove
Stir-fry the vegetables 5 minutes
Whisk the sauce with water until pourable
Toss everything with the noodles and sauce

recipes.name: Baked Cod with Herb Crust
steps: Mix breadcrumbs, parsley, garlic, zest and oil
Press onto the cod
Bake at 200°C for 12 to 15 minutes
Serve with steamed green beans

recipes.name: Turkey Burgers with Sweet Potato Wedges
steps: Roast the wedges with oil at 210°C for 30 minutes
Mix turkey, egg white, garlic and paprika and shape 4 patties
Grill or pan-fry 5 minutes per side
Serve in buns with lettuce, tomato and the wedges

recipes.name: Chicken Noodle Soup
steps: Soften the vegetables in the oil
Add stock, thyme and the chicken and simmer 20 minutes
Shred the chicken
Add noodles for 6 minutes, return the chicken and finish with parsley

recipes.name: Prawn and Chorizo Paella
steps: Fry the chorizo, then soften onion, pepper and garlic
Stir in the rice, paprika and saffron
Pour in the stock and simmer without stirring 15 minutes
Add prawns and peas and cook 5 minutes more
rest and serve with lemon

recipes.name: Spinach and Ricotta Stuffed Shells
steps: Cook the shells until just al dente
Mix ricotta, spinach, egg and parmesan
Fill the shells and set in a dish over half the sauce
Top with remaining sauce and mozzarella and bake at 190°C for 25 minutes

recipes.name: Grilled Swordfish with Salsa Verde
ing: salsa verde: handful parsley and basil, 1 tbsp capers, 1 anchovy, 1 garlic clove, 2 tbsp olive oil, lemon
steps: Blend or chop the salsa verde ingredients
Grill the swordfish 3 to 4 minutes per side
Serve with the salsa verde and salad

recipes.name: Korean Beef Bowl
steps: Cook the rice
Brown the beef with garlic and ginger
Add soy, sugar, sesame oil and gochujang and simmer 2 minutes
Serve over rice with cucumber, spring onion and sesame

recipes.name: Stuffed Chicken Breast with Spinach and Feta
steps: Cut a pocket in each breast
Mix wilted spinach, feta and garlic and stuff the chicken
Sear in the oil and finish in the oven at 200°C for 18 minutes

recipes.name: Shrimp and Grits (Lighter)
steps: Simmer grits in milk and water 20 minutes, stirring, then stir in the cheese
Crisp the turkey bacon and chop
Cook pepper, garlic and shrimp in the same pan
Serve shrimp over grits with bacon and spring onions

recipes.name: Eggplant Parmesan (Baked)
steps: Dip the eggplant in egg then crumbs and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes
Layer with sauce, mozzarella and parmesan
Bake 25 minutes until bubbling
Finish with basil

recipes.name: Venison Steak with Red Cabbage
steps: Braise cabbage with apple, vinegar and honey 25 minutes
Crush juniper and season the steaks
Sear in the oil 2 to 3 minutes per side and rest
Slice and serve with the cabbage

recipes.name: Pesto Chicken Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta
Sear the chicken, slice
Toss pasta with pesto, tomatoes, spinach and chicken
Finish with parmesan

recipes.name: Butter Chicken (Lighter)
steps: Marinate the chicken in yogurt and half the spice
Brown the chicken
Cook onion, garlic, ginger and the rest of the spice in the butter
Add passata and simmer 10 minutes, return the chicken and cream for 10 minutes
Serve with rice

recipes.name: Flank Steak with Chimichurri
ing: chimichurri: large bunch parsley, 3 garlic cloves, 1 tsp oregano, 1/2 tsp chili flakes, 3 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp red wine vinegar
steps: Blend or chop the chimichurri ingredients
Season the steak and grill 4 to 5 minutes per side
Rest 10 minutes and slice against the grain
Spoon over the chimichurri

recipes.name: Steak Fajitas
ing: 600 g skirt or flank steak, sliced
steps: Toss steak and vegetables with the seasoning
Sear the steak in batches in a very hot pan and remove
Cook the vegetables 5 minutes
Return the steak and serve in warm tortillas with salsa and lime

recipes.name: Steak Salad with Blue Cheese and Pear
steps: Sear the steak 3 minutes per side, rest and slice
Toss leaves with oil and vinegar
Top with steak, pear, blue cheese and walnuts

recipes.name: Pepper-Crusted Steak with Mushrooms
steps: Press pepper onto the steaks and sear in the oil 3 to 4 minutes per side, then rest
Cook shallot and mushrooms in the butter
Add stock and crème fraîche and reduce
Serve steak with the mushroom sauce and beans

recipes.name: Steak and Sweet Potato Bowl
steps: Roast sweet potato with cumin and half the oil at 210°C for 25 minutes
Sear the steak and slice
Sauté the kale in the remaining oil
Build bowls with avocado and lime

recipes.name: Beef Kebabs with Vegetables
steps: Marinate the beef with oil, garlic and spices
Thread onto skewers with the vegetables
Grill 10 to 12 minutes, turning
Squeeze over lemon

recipes.name: Beef Pho
ing: 1 onion and thumb of ginger, charred
steps: Simmer the stock with onion, ginger and spices 20 minutes and strain
Season with fish sauce
Put noodles and raw beef in bowls
Pour over the boiling broth to cook the beef and add the toppings

recipes.name: Shepherd's Pie with Sweet Potato Top
ing: 700 g lean lamb or beef mince
steps: Brown the mince with onion and carrots
Add tomato paste, stock and thyme and simmer 20 minutes, adding the peas at the end
Boil and mash the sweet potatoes with the oil
Top the mince with mash and bake at 200°C for 25 minutes

recipes.name: Beef Burrito
steps: Brown beef and onion with the seasoning
Stir in the beans
Fill tortillas with rice, beef, salsa, cheese and lettuce
Roll and toast seam-side down

recipes.name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio with Shrimp
steps: Cook the spaghetti
Gently cook garlic and chili in the oil until golden
Add the shrimp for 2 minutes
Toss with pasta, a splash of pasta water, parsley and lemon zest

recipes.name: Penne Arrabbiata with Chicken
steps: Cook the penne
Sear and slice the chicken
Cook garlic and chili in the oil, add tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes
Toss pasta, sauce and chicken and finish with basil

recipes.name: Creamy Tomato Protein Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta
Blend passata with cottage cheese until smooth
Warm with garlic in the oil
Stir in spinach, toss with pasta, basil and parmesan

recipes.name: Salmon and Broccoli Pasta
steps: Cook pasta with the broccoli for the last 3 minutes
Pan-fry the salmon and flake
Cook garlic in the oil, stir in cream cheese, lemon and pasta water
Toss everything together

recipes.name: Orzo with Chicken, Lemon and Spinach
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil and remove
Toast orzo with garlic
Add stock and simmer 10 minutes, stirring
Stir in chicken, spinach, lemon and dill

recipes.name: Turkey Lasagna (Light)
steps: Brown turkey with onion, add passata and oregano and simmer 15 minutes
Mix ricotta with egg
Layer sauce, sheets and ricotta three times
Top with mozzarella and bake at 180°C for 40 minutes

recipes.name: Pasta e Fagioli
steps: Soften the vegetables in the oil
Add garlic, rosemary, tomatoes, beans and stock and simmer 15 minutes
Add pasta and cook 10 minutes until thick

recipes.name: Soba Noodle Salad with Tofu
ing: dressing: 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tsp maple syrup
steps: Cook and rinse the soba
Sear the tofu
Toss noodles and vegetables with the dressing
Top with tofu and sesame

recipes.name: Spaghetti Squash with Meat Sauce
steps: Halve the squash and roast cut-side down at 200°C for 40 minutes
Brown the mince with onion and garlic, add passata and oregano and simmer 15 minutes
Scrape the squash into strands and top with the sauce

recipes.name: Linguine with Clams
steps: Cook the linguine
Cook garlic and chili in the oil, add clams and wine and cover until they open
Toss with the pasta and parsley

recipes.name: Grilled Salmon with Mango Salsa
steps: Mix mango, onion, chili, coriander and lime
Grill the salmon 4 minutes per side
Serve with rice and the salsa

recipes.name: Tuna Steak with Sesame Crust
steps: Brush tuna with tamari and press into sesame
Sear 1 minute per side for rare
Stir-fry pak choi with ginger
Slice the tuna and serve

recipes.name: Fish Tacos with Cabbage Slaw
ing: slaw: 150 g red cabbage, 2 tbsp Greek yogurt, lime, coriander
steps: Season and cook the fish 3 minutes per side, then flake
Mix the slaw
Fill warm tortillas with fish, slaw and avocado

recipes.name: Baked Trout with Almonds
ing: steamed potatoes and green beans to serve
steps: Bake the trout at 200°C for 12 minutes
Toast the almonds in the butter
Pour over the fish with lemon and parsley

recipes.name: Thai Fish Curry
steps: Fry the curry paste, add coconut milk and bring to a simmer
Add pepper and beans for 4 minutes
Add fish and poach 5 minutes
Season with fish sauce and lime, add basil and serve with rice

recipes.name: Mackerel with Beetroot and Horseradish
steps: Grill the mackerel skin-side up 4 minutes
Mix crème fraîche with horseradish and lemon
Serve on rocket with beetroot and the sauce

recipes.name: Shrimp Scampi with Whole-Wheat Linguine
steps: Cook the linguine
Cook garlic in butter and oil, add shrimp for 2 minutes
Add wine and lemon and reduce
Toss with pasta and parsley

recipes.name: Seared Scallops with Pea Puree
steps: Cook the peas and blend with half the butter and the mint
Sear the scallops in the oil 90 seconds per side
Finish with the remaining butter and lemon
Serve on the pea puree

recipes.name: Halibut with Lemon Caper Sauce
steps: Sear the halibut in the oil 4 minutes per side
Melt butter with capers and lemon
Spoon over the fish and serve with asparagus and potatoes

recipes.name: Chickpea Shakshuka with Spinach
steps: Soften onion and pepper in the oil with the spices
Add tomatoes and chickpeas and simmer 8 minutes
Stir in spinach
Crack in the eggs, cover and cook until set

recipes.name: Vegetable Paella
steps: Soften onion and pepper in the oil
Add zucchini and beans
Stir in rice, paprika and saffron, pour in the stock and simmer 18 minutes without stirring
Add peas and artichokes for the last 5 minutes and serve with lemon

recipes.name: Tofu Poke Bowl
steps: Marinate the tofu in soy and sesame oil
Cook the rice
Build bowls with rice, tofu, vegetables and avocado
Top with ginger and strips of nori

recipes.name: Buddha Bowl with Tahini Dressing
ing: dressing: 2 tbsp tahini, lemon, water, garlic
steps: Roast sweet potato and chickpeas with paprika and oil at 200°C for 25 minutes
Cook the quinoa
Massage the kale with a little dressing
Assemble bowls and drizzle with the tahini dressing

recipes.name: Mushroom Stroganoff
steps: Cook onion and garlic in the butter
Add mushrooms and paprika and brown well
Add stock and reduce by half
Off the heat stir in yogurt and mustard
serve over noodles with parsley

recipes.name: Stuffed Sweet Potatoes with Black Beans
steps: Bake the sweet potatoes at 200°C for 45 minutes
Warm the beans, corn and pepper with cumin
Split the potatoes and fill
Top with salsa, avocado, lime and coriander

recipes.name: Palak Paneer (Lighter)
steps: Blanch the spinach and blend
Brown the paneer in the oil and set aside
Cook onion, garlic, ginger, chili and spices
Add the spinach and yogurt, then the paneer, and simmer 5 minutes

recipes.name: Dal Tadka
ing: tadka: 1 tbsp oil, 1 tsp cumin seeds, 1 onion, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tomato, 1 green chili
steps: Simmer lentils with turmeric in the water for 25 minutes
Fry cumin seeds, then onion, garlic, tomato and chili in the oil
Stir the tadka into the dal and finish with coriander

recipes.name: Falafel Bowl
ing: quinoa, salad and tahini sauce to serve
steps: Blend chickpeas, onion, garlic, herbs, cumin and flour to a coarse paste
Shape into small patties
Brush with oil and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes, turning once
Serve with quinoa, salad and tahini

recipes.name: Tempeh Tacos
steps: Cook the tempeh in the oil with seasoning and a splash of water
Warm the tortillas
Fill with tempeh, cabbage, avocado and salsa

recipes.name: Vegetable Coconut Curry
steps: Fry the curry paste in the oil
Add coconut milk, 200 ml water, sweet potato and cauliflower and simmer 15 minutes
Add chickpeas and spinach
Finish with lime and serve with rice

recipes.name: Quinoa Stuffed Peppers (Vegan)
steps: Cook the quinoa
Mix with beans, corn, half the tomatoes and spices
Fill the halved peppers and pour the rest of the tomatoes around
Cover and bake at 190°C for 30 minutes

recipes.name: Cauliflower Steaks with Romesco
ing: 1 large cauliflower, cut into 2 thick steaks
romesco: 150 g roasted peppers, 30 g almonds, 1 garlic clove, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp sherry vinegar, 1 tbsp olive oil
steps: Brush the steaks with oil and roast at 220°C for 25 minutes, turning once
Blend the romesco ingredients
Serve the steaks on the romesco

recipes.name: Tofu Pad Thai
ing: sauce: 2 tbsp tamari, 1 tbsp tamarind paste, 1 tbsp maple syrup, lime
steps: Soak the noodles
Crisp the tofu in the oil
Add garlic, noodles and sauce and toss 2 minutes
Add sprouts and spring onions and top with peanuts and lime

recipes.name: Greek Stuffed Eggplant (Vegetarian Moussaka Boats)
steps: Roast the eggplant halves with the oil at 200°C for 25 minutes and scoop out a little flesh
Cook onion, lentils, tomatoes, the flesh and spices 10 minutes
Fill the boats
Top with yogurt whisked with egg and parmesan and bake 15 minutes

recipes.name: Jerk Chicken with Rice and Peas
steps: Marinate the chicken in jerk seasoning, lime and oil
Roast at 200°C for 35 minutes
Cook rice with beans, coconut milk, water and thyme
Serve with spring onion

recipes.name: Chicken Adobo
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil
Add soy, vinegar, garlic, bay and pepper with 150 ml water
Simmer covered 30 minutes
Uncover and reduce the sauce 5 minutes

recipes.name: Korean Bibimbap
steps: Cook the rice
Brown the beef with soy
Sauté each vegetable briefly
Fry the eggs
Build bowls with rice, beef, vegetables and egg and top with gochujang and sesame oil

recipes.name: Chicken Souvlaki Bowl
steps: Marinate and grill the chicken
Cook the rice
Build bowls with rice, chicken, salad, olives and tzatziki

recipes.name: Turkish Lentil Kofte with Salad
steps: Cook the lentils in 600 ml water until soft
Stir in bulgur, cover and rest 15 minutes
Cook onion with the pastes and knead everything with cumin and herbs
Shape into ovals and serve in lettuce with lemon

recipes.name: Moroccan Chicken with Couscous
steps: Season and brown the chicken
Soften the onion, add tomatoes and chickpeas and simmer 10 minutes
Return the chicken for 10 minutes
Serve over couscous with coriander and lemon

recipes.name: Ramen with Chicken and Soft Egg
steps: Poach the chicken in the stock with ginger 15 minutes and slice
Whisk in miso and soy off the boil
Cook the noodles and pak choi
Assemble bowls with broth, noodles, chicken, egg and toppings

recipes.name: Pork Carnitas Lettuce Tacos
steps: Rub the pork with spices
Slow-cook with onion, garlic and citrus covered at 160°C for 2.5 hours
Shred and crisp under the grill
Serve in lettuce cups with salsa and coriander

recipes.name: Lamb Chops with Mint Yogurt and Couscous
steps: Season the chops with rosemary and grill 3 to 4 minutes per side
Cook the couscous and fluff with lemon
Mix yogurt with mint and grated cucumber
Serve together

recipes.name: Duck Breast with Orange and Greens
steps: Score the skin and start the duck skin-side down in a cold pan, cooking 12 minutes
Flip for 3 minutes and rest
Reduce the orange juice, honey and vinegar in the pan
Slice the duck and serve with greens, rice and sauce

recipes.name: Bison Burger Lettuce Wrap
steps: Season and shape 2 patties
Grill 4 minutes per side
Wrap in lettuce with onion, tomato, mustard and pickles

recipes.name: Chicken Enchiladas (Light)
steps: Mix chicken, beans, pepper and half the sauce
Fill and roll the tortillas and place in a dish
Pour over the remaining sauce and top with cheese
Bake at 190°C for 25 minutes and serve with yogurt and coriander

recipes.name: Seitan Stir-Fry with Black Bean Sauce
steps: Brown the seitan in the oil
Stir-fry the vegetables with garlic
Add the sauces and a splash of water
Serve over rice

recipes.name: Grilled Chicken Caesar Wrap
steps: Toss romaine with dressing and parmesan
Fill the wraps with chicken and salad
Roll tightly and cut in half

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Sausage and Vegetables
steps: Toss the vegetables and potatoes with oil and herbs
Add the sausages
Roast at 200°C for 30 minutes, turning once

recipes.name: Stuffed Portobello Mushrooms
steps: Brush mushrooms with oil and roast 10 minutes
Mix ricotta, wilted spinach and half the parmesan
Fill, top with crumbs and remaining parmesan and roast 12 minutes more

recipes.name: Egg Fried Cauliflower Rice with Chicken
steps: Cook the chicken in the oil and set aside
Scramble the eggs
Stir-fry the cauliflower rice and vegetables 5 minutes
Return chicken and egg with tamari, sesame oil and spring onions

recipes.name: Greek Chicken Gyros Bowl
steps: Season and grill the chicken, then slice
Toast the pita into strips
Build bowls with rice, chicken, salad, pita and tzatziki

recipes.name: Hainanese Chicken Rice
steps: Poach the chicken with ginger and spring onions in the stock 20 minutes, then rest
Fry garlic briefly and cook the rice in the poaching stock
Blend the chili sauce
Slice the chicken and serve with rice, cucumber and sauce

recipes.name: Swedish Turkey Meatballs with Mash
steps: Mix turkey, egg, onion and allspice and roll into balls
Brown in half the butter
Add stock and milk thickened with cornstarch and simmer 10 minutes
Serve with potatoes mashed with the rest of the butter and a spoon of jam

recipes.name: Irish Salmon Chowder
steps: Soften onion and celery in the butter
Add potatoes and stock and simmer 12 minutes
Add salmon, corn and milk and cook 5 minutes
Finish with dill

recipes.name: Peruvian Lomo Saltado
steps: Sear the beef in very hot oil and remove
Cook onion and chili briefly
Add tomatoes, soy and vinegar, then the beef
Serve with the potatoes, rice and coriander

recipes.name: Brazilian Moqueca (Fish Stew)
steps: Marinate the fish in lime and garlic
Layer onion, peppers and tomatoes in a pot with the oil
Place the fish on top and pour over the coconut milk
Simmer covered 15 minutes and finish with coriander

recipes.name: Georgian Chicken Chkmeruli
steps: Brown the chicken in the butter until cooked through
Add garlic, milk and cream and simmer until thickened
Finish with coriander and serve with salad

recipes.name: Mongolian Beef (Lighter)
steps: Coat the beef in cornstarch and sear in batches in the oil
Cook garlic and ginger
Add soy, sugar and 3 tbsp water and bubble
Toss in the beef and spring onions and serve with rice

recipes.name: Namibian-Style Game Stew with Pap
ing: 1 kg lean game or beef, cubed
steps: Brown the meat in the oil
Add onions, carrots, tomatoes and spices
Add stock and simmer covered for 90 minutes
Cook the maize meal in water, stirring, into a thick pap and serve together

recipes.name: Ribeye Steak with Garlic Mushrooms and Salad
steps: Bring the steaks to room temperature and season
Sear 3 to 4 minutes per side and rest
Cook mushrooms with garlic and butter
Serve with the dressed salad

recipes.name: Steak Stir-Fry with Snap Peas
steps: Sear the beef in hot oil and remove
Stir-fry the vegetables with garlic and ginger
Return the beef with the sauces
Serve with rice

recipes.name: Steak Burrito Bowl
steps: Season and sear the steak, rest and slice
Build bowls with rice, beans, lettuce, steak, salsa, cheese and lime

recipes.name: Philly Cheesesteak Stuffed Peppers
steps: Cook onion, mushrooms and beef in the oil
Fill the peppers
Top with provolone and bake at 190°C for 20 minutes

recipes.name: Steak Tagliata with Rocket and Parmesan
steps: Sear the steaks 3 minutes per side and rest
Slice thinly over rocket and tomatoes
Finish with parmesan, oil and balsamic

recipes.name: Whole-Wheat Spaghetti Carbonara (Lighter)
steps: Cook the spaghetti
Crisp the bacon
Whisk eggs, yolk and parmesan
Toss hot pasta off the heat with bacon and eggs, adding pasta water until silky

recipes.name: Pasta with Tuna, Lemon and Capers
steps: Cook the pasta
Warm the garlic and chili in a little of the tuna oil
Toss pasta with tuna, capers, lemon and parsley

recipes.name: Chicken Pesto Pasta Salad
steps: Cook and cool the pasta
Toss everything together
Keeps 3 days in the fridge

recipes.name: Protein Mac and Cheese
steps: Cook macaroni with the broccoli
Heat milk thickened with cornstarch
Melt in cheddar, cottage cheese and mustard and blend smooth
Stir through the pasta

recipes.name: Beef Ragu with Pappardelle
steps: Brown the beef in the oil
Soften the vegetables, add wine and reduce
Add tomatoes and rosemary and simmer covered 2 hours
Shred the beef and toss with the cooked pasta

recipes.name: Gnocchi with Tomato and Mozzarella
steps: Simmer tomatoes with garlic and oil 10 minutes
Cook the gnocchi and add to the sauce
Top with mozzarella and grill until melted
Finish with basil

recipes.name: Sesame Chicken with Broccoli
ing: sauce: 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp honey, 1 tsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil
steps: Toss chicken in cornstarch and brown in the oil
Steam the broccoli
Add sauce to the chicken and bubble until sticky
Serve with broccoli and rice, sprinkled with sesame

recipes.name: Chicken Parmesan (Baked)
steps: Coat chicken in egg then crumbs mixed with parmesan
Bake at 220°C for 15 minutes
Top with marinara and mozzarella and bake 10 more minutes
Serve with salad or pasta

recipes.name: Coconut Lime Chicken
steps: Brown the chicken
Add garlic, ginger, coconut milk, lime and fish sauce
Simmer 15 minutes
Finish with coriander

recipes.name: Roast Chicken with Root Vegetables
steps: Stuff the chicken with lemon, garlic and thyme
Roast on the vegetables at 200°C for 70 minutes
Rest 10 minutes and remove the skin before serving

recipes.name: Salmon Burgers
steps: Mix salmon, egg, crumbs, spring onion, mustard and zest
Shape 4 patties and chill
Pan-fry 4 minutes per side
Serve in buns with salad

recipes.name: Blackened Fish with Cajun Rice
steps: Cook the rice with the vegetables and half the seasoning
Coat the fish in the rest of the seasoning
Sear in the oil 3 minutes per side
Serve over the rice

recipes.name: Miso-Glazed Cod
steps: Mix miso, mirin, honey and soy
Brush over the cod
Grill 8 to 10 minutes until caramelized
Serve with pak choi and rice

recipes.name: Shrimp and Vegetable Skewers
steps: Toss everything with oil and garlic
Thread onto skewers
Grill 6 to 8 minutes
Finish with lemon and parsley

recipes.name: Tuna Steak Nicoise Bowl
steps: Boil potatoes, beans and eggs
Sear the tuna 1 minute per side
Whisk oil, mustard and lemon
Arrange everything and drizzle

recipes.name: Chickpea Pasta with Roasted Vegetables
steps: Roast the vegetables with oil at 210°C for 25 minutes
Cook the pasta
Toss with the vegetables, basil and chili

recipes.name: Lentil and Sweet Potato Shepherd's Pie (Vegan)
steps: Cook onion, carrots and mushrooms
Add lentils, paste, stock and thyme and simmer 15 minutes
Top with mashed sweet potato
Bake at 200°C for 25 minutes

recipes.name: Protein Energy Balls
steps: Mix everything into a firm dough
Roll into 12 balls
Chill 30 minutes
keeps a week in the fridge

recipes.name: Trail Mix
steps: Mix everything together
Portion into 8 small bags

recipes.name: Hard-Boiled Eggs with Everything Seasoning
ing: 1 tsp everything seasoning (sesame, poppy seed, garlic, onion)
steps: Boil the eggs 9 minutes and cool in cold water
Peel, halve and sprinkle with seasoning

recipes.name: Roasted Chickpeas
steps: Toss chickpeas with oil and spices
Roast at 200°C for 30 minutes, shaking twice, until crisp
Cool completely before storing

recipes.name: Apple Slices with Almond Butter
steps: Slice the apple
Serve with almond butter and cinnamon for dipping

recipes.name: Cottage Cheese with Pineapple
steps: Spoon cottage cheese into a bowl
Top with pineapple

recipes.name: Beef Jerky (Homemade)
ing: 800 g lean beef round, thinly sliced
steps: Marinate the beef overnight
Lay on racks and dry in the oven at 75°C with the door ajar for 4 to 5 hours
Cool and store airtight

recipes.name: Greek Yogurt Ranch Dip with Veggies
steps: Stir the yogurt with herbs, spices and lemon
Serve with vegetable sticks

recipes.name: Edamame Hummus
steps: Blend everything until smooth
Serve with vegetables

recipes.name: Tuna Cucumber Bites
steps: Mix tuna, mayonnaise and mustard
Spoon onto cucumber slices
Dust with paprika

recipes.name: Homemade Granola Bars
steps: Toast oats, nuts and seeds at 180°C for 10 minutes
Warm honey and peanut butter together
Mix everything and press firmly into a lined tin
Bake 15 minutes, cool fully and cut into 12

recipes.name: Turkey and Cheese Roll-Ups
steps: Lay the turkey flat and spread with mustard
Add cheese and cucumber
Roll up tightly

recipes.name: Rice Cakes with Avocado and Egg
steps: Mash the avocado with salt
Spread on the rice cakes
Top with sliced egg and chili flakes

recipes.name: Protein Smoothie Popsicles
steps: Blend everything
Pour into 6 popsicle molds
Freeze at least 4 hours

recipes.name: Kale Chips
steps: Toss kale with oil, yeast and salt
Spread out and bake at 150°C for 18 to 20 minutes until crisp

recipes.name: Deviled Eggs with Greek Yogurt
steps: Halve the eggs and remove the yolks
Mash yolks with yogurt and mustard
Pipe or spoon back in
Top with paprika and chives

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Protein Bites (No Bake)
steps: Mix everything
Roll into 10 balls
Chill until firm

recipes.name: Spiced Nuts
steps: Toss the nuts with maple and spices
Roast at 170°C for 10 minutes
Cool before storing

recipes.name: Cottage Cheese Toast with Tomato
steps: Toast the bread
Top with cottage cheese and tomato
Finish with pepper and basil

recipes.name: Hummus and Veggie Wrap
steps: Spread the hummus on the tortilla
Add the vegetables
Roll and slice

recipes.name: Chocolate Protein Pudding
steps: Stir everything until smooth
Chill 10 minutes if you like

recipes.name: Smoked Salmon Cucumber Rolls
steps: Spread the cucumber strips with cream cheese
Top with salmon and dill
Roll up and secure with a pick

recipes.name: Baked Sweet Potato Fries
steps: Toss with cornstarch, oil and paprika
Spread out on a tray
Bake at 220°C for 25 to 30 minutes, turning once

recipes.name: Pear with Ricotta and Walnuts
steps: Arrange the pear slices
Top with ricotta, walnuts and honey

recipes.name: Chicken Salad Lettuce Cups
steps: Mix chicken with yogurt, celery, mustard and grapes
Spoon into lettuce cups

recipes.name: Date and Nut Energy Bars
steps: Blend almonds to a coarse crumb
Add dates, cocoa, salt and vanilla and blend until it sticks
Press into a lined tin, chill and cut into 10

recipes.name: Popcorn with Parmesan and Herbs
steps: Pop the kernels in a covered pot with the oil
Toss with parmesan and rosemary while hot

recipes.name: Seaweed Rice Crackers with Tuna
steps: Mix tuna with mayonnaise and sriracha
Spoon onto the crackers
Top with nori

recipes.name: Frozen Yogurt Bark
steps: Spread yogurt mixed with honey on a lined tray
Scatter berries and pistachios
Freeze 3 hours and break into pieces

recipes.name: Crispy Chickpea and Seed Mix
steps: Roast chickpeas with oil and curry powder at 200°C for 25 minutes
Add the seeds for the last 5 minutes
Cool and store airtight

recipes.name: Protein Muffin in a Mug
steps: Mix everything in a large mug
Microwave 60 to 90 seconds until risen

recipes.name: Edamame and Sea Salt Snack Pack
steps: Toss the warm edamame with salt
Pack for later

recipes.name: Banana Oat Cookies
steps: Mash bananas and mix with everything
Drop 12 spoonfuls onto a lined tray
Bake at 180°C for 15 minutes

recipes.name: Caprese Skewers
steps: Thread tomato, basil and mozzarella onto small skewers
Drizzle with balsamic

recipes.name: Salsa and Black Bean Dip
ing: vegetable sticks or baked corn tortilla chips
steps: Mash beans with salsa, cumin and lime
Top with coriander
Serve with vegetables or chips

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Celery Boats
steps: Fill the celery with peanut butter
Dot with raisins

recipes.name: Pita Chips with Tzatziki
steps: Cut the pita into wedges and brush with oil and za'atar
Bake at 190°C for 8 minutes
Serve with tzatziki

recipes.name: Mini Frittata Bites
steps: Whisk eggs and milk
Divide vegetables and feta between 12 mini muffin cups
Pour over the egg
Bake at 180°C for 15 minutes

recipes.name: Chocolate Almond Butter Rice Cakes
steps: Spread the rice cakes with almond butter
Drizzle with chocolate
Finish with sea salt

recipes.name: Coconut Chia Energy Bites
steps: Blend everything until sticky
Roll into 12 balls
Chill until firm

recipes.name: Protein Oat Bars (No Bake)
steps: Mix oats and protein powder
Stir in peanut butter, honey and milk
Press into a lined tin and top with melted chocolate
Chill 1 hour and cut into 8

recipes.name: Spicy Roasted Edamame
steps: Toss edamame with oil, chili and salt
Roast at 200°C for 20 minutes until crisp

recipes.name: Turkey Jerky Sticks with Cheese
steps: Pack together for an easy protein snack

recipes.name: Watermelon Mint Cubes with Lime
steps: Toss watermelon with lime, mint and chili salt
Serve cold

recipes.name: Greek Yogurt Bark with Nuts
steps: Spread sweetened yogurt on a lined tray
Scatter nuts and nibs
Freeze 3 hours and break up

recipes.name: Tofu Nuggets (Baked)
steps: Toss tofu with soy sauce, then cornstarch
Coat in panko mixed with spices
Bake at 210°C for 25 minutes, turning once

recipes.name: Hiking Pemmican-Style Bites
steps: Blitz jerky, cranberries, almonds and seeds
Mix with almond butter and maple
Press into 12 small bars and chill

recipes.name: Shrimp and Avocado Bites
steps: Mash avocado with lime and salt
Spoon onto cucumber rounds
Top with a shrimp, chili and coriander

recipes.name: Fig and Walnut Energy Bars
steps: Blend figs and walnuts until sticky
Mix in oats, cinnamon and salt
Press into a tin, chill and cut into 10

recipes.name: Labneh with Za'atar and Veggies
steps: Spread the labneh on a plate
Drizzle with oil and sprinkle with za'atar
Serve with the vegetables

recipes.name: Mixed Berry Protein Shake
steps: Blend until smooth

recipes.name: Quinoa Crisps with Dark Chocolate
steps: Toast the quinoa in a dry pan until it pops
Melt the chocolate and stir in the quinoa
Spoon 10 thin rounds onto a lined tray and sprinkle with salt
Chill until set

recipes.name: Greek Salad
steps: Combine the vegetables and olives in a bowl
Place the feta on top
Dress with olive oil and oregano

recipes.name: Tabbouleh
steps: Soak the bulgur in boiling water for 10 minutes and drain well
Mix with tomatoes, herbs and spring onions
Dress with lemon, olive oil and salt

recipes.name: Chicken Caesar Salad (Light)
steps: Season and grill the chicken, then slice
Whisk yogurt, mustard, garlic, anchovy, lemon and half the parmesan into a dressing
Toss the lettuce with the dressing
Top with chicken and remaining parmesan

recipes.name: Gazpacho
steps: Roughly chop the vegetables
Blend everything until very smooth
Season and chill for at least 1 hour

recipes.name: Hummus with Crudités
ing: carrots, cucumber and peppers for dipping
steps: Blend chickpeas, tahini, lemon and garlic
Add ice water gradually until very smooth
Serve drizzled with olive oil and the vegetables

recipes.name: Tuna Nicoise Salad
steps: Boil eggs 8 minutes and blanch the beans 3 minutes
Whisk oil, mustard and vinegar
Arrange potatoes, beans, tuna, tomatoes, olives and halved eggs
Drizzle with the dressing

recipes.name: Caprese Salad
steps: Slice the tomatoes and mozzarella
Alternate on a plate with basil
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic and season

recipes.name: Miso Soup with Tofu
steps: Simmer kombu in water 5 minutes then remove
Soak wakame 5 minutes
Take the pot off the boil and whisk in the miso
Add tofu, wakame and spring onions

recipes.name: Shrimp Cocktail with Avocado
steps: Mix passata, horseradish and lemon into a sauce
Toss the shrimp in half the sauce
Serve on lettuce with avocado and cucumber and the remaining sauce

recipes.name: Lentil Soup
steps: Soften onion and carrot in the oil
Add spices, lentils and stock
Simmer 25 minutes and blend until smooth
Serve with lemon

recipes.name: Beetroot and Goat Cheese Salad
steps: Slice the beetroot
Toss the rocket with oil and vinegar
Top with beetroot, crumbled goat cheese and walnuts

recipes.name: Chicken Lettuce Wraps
steps: Brown the chicken in the sesame oil
Add garlic, ginger and water chestnuts
Season with tamari and vinegar
Spoon into lettuce cups

recipes.name: Tomato Bruschetta
steps: Toast the bread
Rub with the cut garlic
Mix tomatoes, basil, oil and salt and spoon on top

recipes.name: Fattoush
steps: Chop the vegetables and herbs
Whisk lemon, oil and sumac
Toss everything together with the pita pieces just before serving

recipes.name: Chicken and Vegetable Soup
steps: Soften the vegetables in the oil
Add stock, bay leaf and whole chicken breasts
Simmer 25 minutes
Shred the chicken, return to the pot and finish with parsley

recipes.name: Edamame with Sea Salt and Chili
steps: Boil the edamame 4 minutes and drain
Toss with sesame oil, salt and chili

recipes.name: Salmon Tartare
steps: Mix salmon with shallot, capers and chives
Stir in mustard, oil and lemon
Season and shape in a ring
serve cold

recipes.name: Roasted Tomato Soup
steps: Roast tomatoes, pepper, onion and garlic with the oil at 200°C for 30 minutes
Blend with the stock
Season and finish with basil

recipes.name: Quinoa Tabbouleh
steps: Cook and cool the quinoa
Dice the vegetables and chop the herbs
Toss everything with lemon, oil and salt

recipes.name: Thai Beef Salad
steps: Sear the steak 3 minutes per side, rest and slice thinly
Whisk lime, fish sauce and honey
Toss the steak with cucumber, onion, herbs and chili
Dress and scatter with peanuts

recipes.name: Mushroom Soup (Light)
steps: Cook onion and garlic in the butter
Add mushrooms and thyme and cook 8 minutes
Add stock and simmer 10 minutes
Blend with the milk

recipes.name: Stuffed Mushrooms with Spinach
steps: Heat oven to 190°C
Remove stems and chop them
Cook stems, garlic and spinach, then mix with ricotta
Fill the caps, top with parmesan and bake 15 minutes

recipes.name: Chickpea Salad with Lemon and Herbs
steps: Chop the vegetables and parsley
Toss with the chickpeas
Dress with lemon, oil, cumin and salt

recipes.name: Vietnamese Summer Rolls with Shrimp
ing: dipping sauce: 2 tbsp hoisin with 1 tbsp water
steps: Dip each rice paper in warm water for a few seconds
Layer lettuce, noodles, carrot, herbs and shrimp
Roll up tightly
Serve with the dipping sauce

recipes.name: Baba Ganoush
steps: Char the eggplants over a flame or under a grill until collapsed
Scoop out the flesh and drain
Mash with tahini, garlic and lemon
Top with oil, parsley and pomegranate

recipes.name: Asian Cucumber Salad
steps: Salt the cucumbers for 5 minutes and drain
Mix garlic, vinegar, tamari, sesame oil and chili
Toss and sprinkle with sesame seeds

recipes.name: Watermelon Feta Mint Salad
steps: Combine watermelon, onion and mint
Crumble over feta
Dress with oil and lime

recipes.name: Carrot Ginger Soup
steps: Soften onion and ginger in the oil
Add carrots and stock and simmer 20 minutes
Blend with the coconut milk until smooth

recipes.name: Kale Salad with Lemon and Parmesan
steps: Massage the kale with lemon, oil and salt for 2 minutes
Top with shaved parmesan and almonds

recipes.name: Ceviche
steps: Cover the fish with lime juice and chill 15 minutes until opaque
Add onion, chili and coriander
Season and serve with the sweet potato

recipes.name: Tzatziki with Vegetables
steps: Mix yogurt, cucumber, garlic and dill
Season with lemon and salt
Drizzle with oil and serve with vegetables

recipes.name: Minestrone
steps: Soften onion, carrot and celery in the oil
Add zucchini, tomatoes and stock and simmer 15 minutes
Add beans and pasta and cook 10 minutes
Finish with basil

recipes.name: Spicy Tuna Avocado Boats
steps: Mix tuna, mayonnaise, sriracha and spring onion
Pile into the avocado halves
Sprinkle with sesame seeds

recipes.name: Greek Lemon Chicken Soup (Avgolemono)
steps: Poach the chicken in the stock 20 minutes, then shred
Cook the rice in the stock
Whisk eggs with lemon, temper with hot stock, then stir back in off the boil
Return the chicken and finish with dill

recipes.name: Seaweed Salad
steps: Soak the wakame 10 minutes and squeeze dry
Whisk the dressing
Toss and sprinkle with sesame seeds

recipes.name: Grilled Halloumi Salad
steps: Grill the halloumi 2 minutes per side
Toss the salad with oil and lemon
Top with halloumi and mint

recipes.name: Black Bean Soup
steps: Soften onion, pepper and garlic
Add spices, beans and stock and simmer 20 minutes
Blend half and stir back in
Finish with lime and coriander

recipes.name: Prosciutto-Wrapped Melon
steps: Wrap each melon wedge in prosciutto
Season with pepper and garnish with mint

recipes.name: Roasted Pepper and Feta Dip
steps: Blend everything until smooth
Serve with vegetables or warm pita

recipes.name: Crab Cakes (Baked)
steps: Heat oven to 200°C
Mix crab, egg, mayonnaise, mustard, spring onion and half the panko
Shape 8 cakes and coat with the rest of the panko
Bake 15 minutes, turning once

recipes.name: Moroccan Carrot Salad
steps: Toss warm carrots with spices, lemon and oil
Rest 10 minutes
Finish with parsley

recipes.name: Pea and Mint Soup
steps: Soften the onion in the oil
Add peas and stock and simmer 5 minutes
Blend with the mint

recipes.name: Egg Drop Soup
steps: Bring stock to a simmer and thicken with the cornstarch
Stir in soy sauce
Drizzle in beaten eggs while stirring slowly
Finish with sesame oil and spring onion

recipes.name: Tomato and Chickpea Soup
steps: Soften onion and garlic
Add cumin and harissa
Add tomatoes, chickpeas and stock and simmer 15 minutes
Blend half for texture

recipes.name: Smoked Trout Salad
steps: Flake the trout over watercress and apple
Mix crème fraîche with horseradish and lemon
Drizzle and finish with dill

recipes.name: Chilled Cucumber Yogurt Soup
steps: Blend everything except the oil
Season and chill
Serve with a drizzle of oil

recipes.name: Asparagus with Egg and Parmesan
steps: Blanch or grill the asparagus
Top with halved eggs
Finish with parmesan, oil and lemon zest

recipes.name: Chicken Satay Skewers
ing: sauce: 2 tbsp peanut butter, 1 tbsp lime juice, 2 tbsp coconut milk, 1 tsp chili sauce
steps: Marinate the chicken with tamari and curry powder 10 minutes
Thread onto skewers and grill 8 to 10 minutes
Whisk the sauce ingredients
Serve the skewers with the sauce

recipes.name: Burrata with Roasted Tomatoes
steps: Roast the tomatoes with oil at 200°C for 12 minutes
Place burrata in the center of a plate
Spoon the tomatoes around and finish with basil and balsamic

recipes.name: Spiced Pumpkin Soup
steps: Roast the pumpkin with half the oil at 200°C for 20 minutes
Soften onion with curry powder
Add pumpkin and stock, simmer 5 minutes and blend with coconut milk
Top with seeds

recipes.name: Mussels in White Wine
steps: Soften shallots and garlic in the butter
Add wine and bring to the boil
Add mussels, cover and steam 4 to 5 minutes until open
Discard any closed ones and finish with parsley

recipes.name: Shaved Fennel and Orange Salad
steps: Arrange fennel, orange and rocket
Scatter the olives
Drizzle with olive oil and the orange juice from cutting
